arxiv-2101-03434.title: Noetherian spaces in choiceless set theory 2020 AMS subject classification 03E25, 03E35.
arxiv-2101-03434.creator: Jindřich Zapletal
arxiv-2101-03434.description: Abstract I prove several independence results in the choiceless ZF+DC theory which separate algebraic and non-algebraic consequences of the axiom of choice. 1 Introduction Geometric set theory [ 5 ] was developed in part to produce consistency results in choiceless ZF+DC set theory regarding various \Sigma^{2}_{1} sentences.

arxiv-2110-08895.title: Deep Clustering for General-Purpose Audio Representations
arxiv-2110-08895.creator: Sreyan Ghosh, Sandesh V Katta, Ashish Seth, S. Umesh
arxiv-2110-08895.description: Abstract We introduce DECAR , a self-supervised pre-training approach for learning general-purpose audio representations. Our system is based on clustering: it utilizes an offline clustering step to provide target labels that act as pseudo-labels for solving a prediction task. We develop on top of recent advances in self-supervised learning for computer vision and design a lightweight, easy-to-use self-supervised pre-training scheme.

arxiv-2202-12472.title: Bidding Agent Design in the LinkedIn Ad Marketplace
arxiv-2202-12472.creator: Yuan Gao, Kaiyu Yang, Yuanlong Chen, Min Liu, Noureddine El Karoui
arxiv-2202-12472.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yuan Gao, Kaiyu Yang, Yuanlong Chen, Min Liu, Noureddine El Karoui. We establish a general optimization framework for the design of automated bidding agent in dynamic online marketplaces. It optimizes solely for the buyer’s interest and is agnostic to the auction mechanism imposed by the seller. As a result, the framework allows, for instance, the joint optimization of a group of ads across multiple platforms each running its own auction format.

arxiv-2206-12058.title: A central limit theorem for square ice
arxiv-2206-12058.creator: Wei Wu
arxiv-2206-12058.description: Abstract . We prove that the height function associated with the uniform six-vertex model (or equivalently, the uniform homomorphism height function from ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}^{2} to ℤ \mathbb{Z} ) satisfies a central limit theorem, upon some logarithmic rescaling. 1. introduction The six vertex model was initially proposed by Pauling [ 18 ] as an ideal model for ice.

arxiv-2308-03763.creator: A Study of Hamiltonian Systems

arxiv-2405-13984.title: Less for More: Enhanced Feedback-aligned Mixed LLMs for Molecule Caption Generation and Fine-Grained NLI Evaluation
arxiv-2405-13984.creator: Dimitris Gkoumas, Maria Liakata
arxiv-2405-13984.description: Abstract Scientific language models drive research innovation but require extensive fine-tuning on large datasets. This work enhances such models by improving their inference and evaluation capabilities with minimal or no additional training. Focusing on molecule caption generation, we explore post-training synergies between alignment fine-tuning and model merging in a cross-modal setup.

arxiv-2503-09139.title: Tiny-Scale Properties within the Interstellar Medium towards PSR J1644 − - 4559: I. Observational Evidence of Turbulence-induced Tiny Scale Atomic Structures
arxiv-2503-09139.creator: Mengting Liu, Di Li, J. R. Dawson, Joel M. Weisberg, Snežana Stanimirović, George Hobbs, Simon Johnston, Lawrence Toomey, Siyao Xu, Chao-Wei Tsai, Donghui Quan, Stacy Mader, James A. Green, Lei Zhang, Ningyu Tang, Pei Wang, Kai Zhang, Pei Zuo, Gan Luo, Yi Feng, Shi Dai, Aditi Kaushik, Mengyao Xue, C
arxiv-2503-09139.description: Abstract We investigated H i absorption toward a single pulsar, PSR J1644 − - 4559, and its variability over timescales from days to years, using Murriyang, CSIRO’s Parkes Radio Telescope. Our 19 epochs of spectral observations, spanning 1.2 years with intervals as short as 1 day, provide the most comprehensive cadence coverage for monitoring H i absorption to date.

arxiv-2505-18108.title: Universal geometrical link invariants
arxiv-2505-18108.creator: Cristina Anghel, / ⁣ / /\!\!/, 23 rd May 2025
arxiv-2505-18108.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Cristina Anghel, / ⁣ / /\!\!/, 23 rd May 2025. We construct geometrically two universal link invariants : universal ADO invariant and universal Jones invariant, as limits of invariants given by graded intersections in configuration spaces. More specificaly, for a fixed level 𝒩 \mathcal{N} , we define new link invariants: “ 𝒩 t ​ h \mathcal{N}^{th} Unified Jones invariant” and “ 𝒩 t ​ h \mathcal{N}^{th} Unified Alexander invariant” .

arxiv-2507-00631.title: Operator: A Protocol for Trustless Delegation Under Uncertainty
arxiv-2507-00631.creator: David Shi, Kevin Joo
arxiv-2507-00631.description: Abstract Correctness is an emergent property of systems where exposing error is cheaper than committing it. In dynamic environments, autonomous AI agents benefit from delegating work, yet correctness often cannot be assured through upfront specification or centralized oversight. We propose a protocol that enforces correctness through collateralized claims in a recursive verification game.

arxiv-2508-15634.title: Submanifolds with boundary in sub-Riemannian Heisenberg Groups Thanks: M. D. M. and D. V. are supported by University of Padova and GNAMPA of INdAM. D. arxiv-2508-15634.description: Abstract . We discuss the notion of submanifolds with boundary with intrinsic C 1 C^{1} regularity in sub-Riemannian Heisenberg groups and we provide some examples. Eventually, we present a Stokes’ Theorem for such submanifolds involving the integration of Rumin’s differential forms in Heisenberg groups. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C17, 26B20, 53C65, 58C35. 1.

arxiv-2510-10388.title: On the Complexity of Horizontal Unitracks.
arxiv-2510-10388.creator: Ivan Molodyk
arxiv-2510-10388.description: Abstract This paper concerns the geometry of bicycle tracks. We model bicycle as an oriented segment of a fixed length that is moving in the Euclidean plane so that the trajectory of the rear point is tangent to the segment at all times.

arxiv-2601-05295.title: More Exact Thermodynamic Analysis of Topological Black Holes in R 2 R^{2} Gravity
arxiv-2601-05295.creator: and Abhishek Ashish
arxiv-2601-05295.description: Abstract This study investigates the thermodynamics of topological black hole solutions in R 2 R^{2} gravity, incorporating the effects of small statistical fluctuations up to first-order corrections. We precisely calculate entropy, internal energy, Helmholtz free energy, specific heat, enthalpy, and Gibbs free energy, accounting for perturbative thermal corrections.

arxiv-2602-10636.title: Explicit form of relaxation tensor for isotropic extended Burgers model and its spectral inversion
arxiv-2602-10636.creator: Youjun Deng, Ching-Lung Lin, Gen Nakamura
arxiv-2602-10636.description: Abstract Concerning the anelastic nature of Earth, the quasi-static extended Burgers model (abbreviated by q-EBM), an integro-differential system, is used to study the free oscillation of Earth (abbreviated by FOE). In this paper, we first provide a general method to obtain an explicit form of the relaxation tensor for inhomogeneous isotropic q-EBM.

marlowe-tamburlaine-part2-1590.creator: Christopher Marlowe
marlowe-tamburlaine-part2-1590.description: Tamburlaine's fall — the conqueror undone by grief and his own mortality.

pmc-10509578.title: Estimation of epidemiological parameters and ascertainment rate from early transmission of COVID-19 across Africa
pmc-10509578.creator: Qing Han, Nicola Bragazzi, Ali Asgary, James Orbinski, Jianhong Wu, Jude Dzevela Kong
pmc-10509578.description: Country reported case counts suggested a slow spread of SARS-CoV-2 in the initial phase of the COVID-19 pandemic in Africa. Owing to inadequate public awareness, unestablished monitoring practices, limited testing and stigmas, there might exist extensive under-ascertainment of the true number of cases, especially at the beginning of the novel epidemic.

pmc-10594433.title: Urine-HILIC: Automated Sample Preparation for Bottom-Up Urinary Proteome Profiling in Clinical Proteomics
pmc-10594433.creator: Ireshyn Selvan Govender, Rethabile Mokoena, Stoyan Stoychev, Previn Naicker, Rui Vitorino
pmc-10594433.description: Urine provides a diverse source of information related to a patient’s health status and is ideal for clinical proteomics due to its ease of collection. To date, most methods for the preparation of urine samples lack the throughput required to analyze large clinical cohorts.

pmc-10626190.title: Dual-modality imaging of immunofluorescence and imaging mass cytometry for whole-slide imaging and accurate segmentation
pmc-10626190.creator: Eun Na Kim, Phyllis Zixuan Chen, Dario Bressan, Monika Tripathi, Ahmad Miremadi, Massimiliano di Pietro, Lisa M Coussens, Gregory J Hannon, Rebecca C Fitzgerald, Lizhe Zhuang, Young Hwan Chang
pmc-10626190.description: SummaryImaging mass cytometry (IMC) is a powerful technique capable of detecting over 30 markers on a single slide. It has been increasingly used for single-cell-based spatial phenotyping in a wide range of samples. However, it only acquires a rectangle field of view (FOV) with a relatively small size and low image resolution, which hinders downstream analysis.

pmc-10728726.title: Morphological and multi-gene phylogenetic analyses reveal five new hyphomycetes from freshwater habitats
pmc-10728726.creator: Ya-Zhou Zhang, Qi-Lei Chen, Jian Ma, Yong-Zhong Lu, Hu-Biao Chen, Ning-Guo Liu
pmc-10728726.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). During the survey on freshwater hyphomycetes in Guangxi, Guizhou and Hainan Provinces, China, five fresh collections were encountered. Based on their morphology, these five isolates were identified as belonging to Hermatomyces, Kirschsteiniothelia, Paramonodictys, Pleopunctum and Sparticola. Multi-gene phylogenetic analyses were performed for each genus, which resulted in the identification of five new species, namely Hermatomyces hainanensis, Kirschsteiniothelia ramus, Paramonodictys globosa, Pleopunctum guizhouense, and Sparticola irregularis. Detailed descriptions and illustrations of the morphological characteristics of these new taxa were provided.

pmc-11369478.title: Assessing climate-driven impacts on Karakoram glacier surge: A geospatial analysis highlighting Shishper Glacial Lake outburst flood events (2019–2022) as prime example
pmc-11369478.creator: Mehtabidah Ali
pmc-11369478.description: The Northern Areas of Pakistan encompass the Hindukush, Karakoram, and Himalayan mountain ranges witnessing glacier surging, exacerbated by climate warming. As glaciers rapidly melt, ravines experience heightened blockage and migration, obstructing stream discharges and forming expansive ice-dammed lakes. The rupture of these natural dams triggers Glacial Lake Outburst Floods downstream in the primary glacier's ravine.

pmc-11577457.title: Short-term effectiveness and safety of ustekinumab and vedolizumab in elderly and non-elderly patients with Crohn’s disease: a comparative study
pmc-11577457.creator: Lior Dar, Uria Shani, Arad Dotan, Offir Ukashi, Shomron Ben-Horin, Uri Kopylov, Asaf Levartovsky
pmc-11577457.description: Background:Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) presents unique challenges in elderly patients due to comorbidities and treatment-related risks.Objectives:This study evaluates ustekinumab (UST) and vedolizumab (VDZ) efficacy and safety in elderly Crohn’s disease (CD) patients.Design:A retrospective cohort study at a tertiary medical center.

pmc-11585544.title: Expression and regulation of SETBP1 in the song system of male zebra finches (Taeniopygia guttata) during singing
pmc-11585544.creator: Dana Jenny Grönberg, Sara Luisa Pinto de Carvalho, Nikola Dernerova, Phillip Norton, Maggie Mei-Ki Wong, Ezequiel Mendoza
pmc-11585544.description: Rare de novo heterozygous loss-of-function SETBP1 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by speech deficits, indicating a potential involvement of SETBP1 in human speech. However, the expression pattern of SETBP1 in brain regions associated with vocal learning remains poorly understood, along with the underlying molecular mechanisms linking it to vocal production.

pmc-11603891.title: Toxoplasmosis in a case with multiple serous effusions and severe aplastic anemia
pmc-11603891.creator: Xiaoning Wang, Hao Li, Le Ma, Juan Ren, Fatahichegeni Mahsa, Ansarian Mohammad Amin, Jing Zhao, Mei Zhang, Pengcheng He
pmc-11603891.description: Toxoplasmosis, a parasitic disease, can cause fatal multi-organ failure in immunocompromised patients. The lack of specificity in the symptoms and the need to confirm a diagnosis of tachyzoites in fluids or tissues through microscopic examination leads to a delay in reaching a diagnosis. A 28-year-old woman with severe aplastic anemia received stem cell transplantation seven months ago, presented with fever.

pmc-11711161.title: Factors related to surgical site infection in spinal instrumentation surgery: a retrospective study in Japan
pmc-11711161.creator: Kazumasa Konishi, Hideto Sano, Yosuke Kawano, Takehiko Moroi, Takumi Takeuchi, Masahito Takahashi, Naobumi Hosogane
pmc-11711161.description: Study DesignA retrospective study.PurposeTo identify factors involved in surgical site infections (SSIs) after spinal instrumentation surgery performed at a single institution.Overview of LiteratureSSIs after spinal instrumentation surgery are a serious complication. Despite reports on risk factors for SSIs in spine surgery, limited studies are related to spinal instrumentation surgery.MethodsIn total, 828 patients (338 males and 490 females; mean age, 65.

pmc-11826395.title: The Role of Epigenetics in Myocardial Infarction: Mechanism, Biomarkers and Therapeutic Potential
pmc-11826395.creator: Arash Amin, Mohsen Abbasnezhad, Ali Keshavarzian, Ahmadreza Badali, Roohollah Rahbani, Reza Faramarz Zadeh
pmc-11826395.description: Myocardial infarction (MI), remains one of the leading causes of morbidity and mortality worldwide. As a result, understanding the underlying mechanisms of MI is crucial for developing effective therapeutic strategies. Epigenetics, which involves heritable changes in gene expression without altering the underlying DNA sequence, has emerged as a significant factor in the pathogenesis and progression of MI.

pmc-12375807.title: Hirayama disease: a rare cause of cervical myelopathy
pmc-12375807.creator: Amin Khan, Aditya Duhan, Rajiv Mangla, Manisha Mangla, Sajjad Ghanim Al-Badri
pmc-12375807.description: Hirayama disease (HD) is a rare cervical myelopathy involving lower cervical myotomes, causing asymmetric or unilateral distal upper extremity muscle atrophy. Diagnosis relies on clinical findings, nerve conduction studies, and cervical spine MRI in neutral and flexion positions. We present a 17-year-old male with painless, progressive weakness and atrophy of the left forearm and hand muscles, along with hyperhidrosis.

pmc-12584342.title: Neither uni- nor multi-modal exercise interventions improved single- and dual-task gait performance in physically active healthy elderly – a pilot study
pmc-12584342.creator: Constantin W. Freitag, Martin Behrens, Robert Bielitzki, Tom Behrendt, Khaldoon O. Al-Nosairy, Francie H. Stolle, Gokulraj T. Prabhakaran, Rosalie Beyer, Cynthia Moffack Djuloun, Hagen Thieme, Michael B. Hoffmann, Lutz Schega
pmc-12584342.description: PurposeAging is an inevitable process leading, inter alia, to the loss of muscle mass as well as the decrease in physical and cognitive function. These age-related impairments translate into a reduced gait performance and an increased risk of falls, which can be tackled with resistance training, Unimodal intervention (UMI). However, Multimodal intervention (MMI), i.e.

pmc-12766421.title: A barrier-forming gel for oral mucositis in head and neck cancers patients undergoing radiotherapy: randomized, controlled, multicenter trial
pmc-12766421.creator: Jinlong Wei, Qin Zhao, Sitong Chang, Yulei Chen, Jie Wu, Chuncheng Hao, Wenxue Zhang, Xia Li, Haijun Lu, Xiaojing Jia, Bing Wang, Yan Ma, Aifu Wang, Xin Jiang
pmc-12766421.description: SummaryBackgroundEpisil is a type of barrier-forming gel. This study was to observe the effects of Episil on oral mucositis (OM) and nutritional status in patients with head and neck cancer (HNC) receiving radiotherapy.MethodsA multicenter and randomized controlled trial included 200 intention-to-treat patients across 7 medical centers in China from February 2022 to June 2024.

pmc-13253179.title: Computer‐Aided Sperm Analysis Protocol for Evaluating Sperm Motility in Japanese Medaka
pmc-13253179.creator: Miwa Kuroyanagi, Satoshi Ansai, Keigo Okamoto, Ai Kato, Touko Yamazaki, Yasuhiro Kamei, Eiji Watanabe, Kiyoshi Naruse, Yukiko Ogino
pmc-13253179.description: Changes in sperm motility can serve as an early indicator of reproductive effects caused by environmental chemicals or genetic perturbations. However, sperm motility is highly sensitive to external factors such as osmolarity, ionic composition, and the timing of measurement after activation, making it challenging to obtain consistent and reproducible measurements.

pmc-13415531.title: A detection method for dense emitters based on a separation and boundary-aware collaborative enhancement detection network
pmc-13415531.creator: Ziyi Zhang, Youchen Fan, Shunhu Hou, Maolin Tang, Shengliang Fang
pmc-13415531.description: To address the low detection efficiency of dense emitters in radio environment maps, this paper analyzes two fundamental challenges: feature confusion, which causes merged targets and increases missed detections, and boundary ambiguity, which blurs edges and raises false alarms. Together, they create a precision–recall dilemma.

pmc-13538821.title: Cardiovascular Autonomic Neuropathy and Indices of Heart Failure in Type 2 Diabetes: The CANCAN Study
pmc-13538821.creator: Jonas R Schaarup, Lasse Bjerg, Christian S Hansen, Daniel R Witte, Henrik H Thomsen, Jesper Fleischer, Rodica Pop‐Busui, Signe T Andersen

pmc-13587643.title: Fully Reversible Regulation of 8‐17 DNAzyme Activity Using Nucleoside‐Based Diarylethenes
pmc-13587643.creator: Jörn Bargstedt, Simon M Büllmann, Sophia Conwell, Andres Jäschke
pmc-13587643.description: Controlling enzyme activity with external triggers is a central goal in chemical biology. Light is an especially attractive stimulus because it is noninvasive, offers high spatiotemporal precision, and can reversibly modulate molecular function. In this study, we use nucleoside‐based diarylethenes (DAEs) to achieve light‐dependent control of the RNA‐cleaving deoxyribozyme (DNAzyme) 8–17.

pmc-13633173.title: Human Life History is Shaping Embodied Medicinal Plant Knowledge Across the Lifespan
pmc-13633173.creator: Jorge Izaquiel Alves de Siqueira, Patrícia Muniz de Medeiros, Ulysses Paulino Albuquerque
pmc-13633173.description: In this study, we draw on theoretical frameworks from Life History Theory, and Embodied Capital Theory to assess the role of human life history in shaping local medical systems (LMSs) across the lifespan. We focus specifically on medicinal plants, as they can enhance individual fitness and contribute to overall health.

pmc-13645503.title: P2Y12 Inhibitor Selection and Ischemic Outcomes in Patients with Acute Coronary Syndrome Undergoing Percutaneous Coronary Intervention: A Real-World Registry Analysis
pmc-13645503.creator: Donghyeon Joo, Jeong Tae Byoun, Sungho Jo, Jae Young Cho, Kyeong Ho Yun
pmc-13645503.description: This study evaluated whether ticagrelor use is associated with improved ischemic outcomes compared with clopidogrel in Korean patients with acute coronary syndrome undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention. We analyzed patient-level data from 1,199 patients (614 clopidogrel, 585 ticagrelor) enrolled in two prospective registries. Stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) was applied to balance baseline characteristics between the two groups.
